_comment: This file exists so that 'Perth' stops being a string literal. It was
the rewrite slug of the specialty taxonomy, the path of the hub, the
fallback in the answer block, the AdministrativeArea in the schema, and
a hard-coded word in roughly twenty files. None of that is wrong for a
one-city directory. All of it is a migration for a two-city one.
`default` is the city assumed when nothing else identifies one. Exactly
one city may hold it. It is what keeps every existing Perth URL working
byte-for-byte while the code underneath stops being about Perth.
Adding a city is a change to this file plus its area terms and its
listings. It should never again be a change to the code.
`region` is the schema.org AdministrativeArea. `centre` is used for
distance and map defaults, not for anything a page asserts.
